say:1:1130918001:1.text: Ha! If you wanna blame someone, blame our boss for taking on this job. No choice now but to just get it done.
say:1:1130918001:1.source_cn: 哈！谁让我们老大接了委托呢。这世道就是这样，不管有多不...

say:2:1130918002:1.text: If that Mauler girl's reward wasn't so huge that the boss promised us a bigger cut, I would've walked a long time ago.
say:2:1130918002:1.source_cn: 要不是那个蛮血女孩给的报酬特别丰厚，老大还答应多给我们...

say:3:1130918003:1.text: Then again, so what if she's offering a big reward? What could possibly compare to the Dusk Lord's hidden treasure? We're bounty hunters, after all!
say:3:1130918003:1.source_cn: 话又说回来了，报酬再丰厚又怎么样，能和残阳神的宝藏比吗...

say:4:1130918004:1.text: What a pain! Maybe I should just fly solo on this one...
say:4:1130918004:1.source_cn: 真纠结！我要不要出去单干呢……
